author: Wolfgang Sander
text:
It's not an expiration date.
With the "use by" date, Abbott guarantees the sterility of the setting needle and filament. The sensor still works after it has expired, but Abbott will not replace it in the event of errors.

author: Gene Holcombe
text: They should be fine up to about 2 months past expiration. Anything beyond that, throw them out.  It’s not worth getting errant readings

author: Doug Blair
text: Mate they are still good to use a couple of years out of date np as long as they have been safely stored.
